second_pass_findings.corridor_desc: RETRY RESULT: still unresolved. END point remains well corroborated (2+ independent public sources: Wikipedia, Offshore Technology, Global Energy Observatory; Eni's Mar-2021 press release on the Damietta LNG restart). START point: a dedicated retry search (English + Arabic, GASCO/EGAS materials, Eni press content, OSM/Overpass tagged-infrastructure query) still found no independently named, specific take-off/metering/dispatching station for the ~12km national-grid tie-in distinct from the SEGAS plant itself -- only the generic 'national gas grid' framing survives in public sources. The 'New Damietta industrial/urban zone' Wikipedia city-center anchor is confirmed as the best defensible public anchor available, but it is explicitly a broad-area placeholder, not a facility-level fix, so resolved is kept false rather than overstating confidence. Recommend a human decide whether this corridor-level start point is acceptable for a straight-line route, or pursue GASCO/EGAS internal materials to name the actual station.
